title: All Recovery - Photos, Videos
summary: Recovery for photos, videos, files and saved message notifications.
description:
All Recovery - Photos, Videos helps you locate and restore deleted photos, videos, audio files, and documents stored on your Android device or SD card. The app scans your storage and shows items that may still be recoverable so you can preview them before restoring.

👍 What you can do
• Recover deleted photos and videos from phone storage or SD card
• Preview found items before restoring
• Restore multiple files at once with batch recovery
• Sort and filter by type, date, or size
• Clean up duplicate or unused files to help save storage space
• View saved message notifications from supported apps (requires Notification Access)

📧 Message notifications
If you choose to enable Notification Access, the app can save and display notifications that were shown on your device from supported apps (for example, WhatsApp).
This feature works by reading the content of notifications you receive after permission is enabled, so you can review those notifications later.
It does not sign in to your accounts, does not access your chat history, and cannot recover messages that were never displayed as notifications or were received before permission was granted.

📂 Supported file types
• Photos: JPG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, RAW
• Videos: MP4, MOV, MKV (device dependent)
• Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, and more
• Documents: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPT, TXT, and more
• Messages: saved notifications from supported messaging apps

📝 Important notes
• Recovery results depend on device model, storage condition, and time since deletion
• Items deleted long ago, overwritten by new data, or removed after a factory reset may not be recoverable
• Cloud-only items (for example, Google Photos backups) are not recoverable unless they exist on local storage

🔐 Privacy
Scanning and recovery run locally on your device. The app does not upload your files or saved notifications and does not share personal data.
